The '''GenScan''' was a model of [[scanner]] made by [[CUE]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The device cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CUE GenScan was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
